# Model Rankings

## 🚨 PIPELINE RESET — PR #137 Equity-Based Metrics + Formula Recalibration

**All evaluations before Mar 16 are STALE.** PR #137 changed `max_drawdown`, `sharpe_ratio`, and `sortino_ratio` to equity-curve-based computation. Strategist recalibrated ALL 17 active task scorer formulas on Mar 15. First new-metric evaluations expected **Mon Mar 16 ~02:15Z**.

### ⚠️ Threshold Recalibration REQUIRED

| Threshold | Current | Recommended | Justification |
|-----------|---------|-------------|---------------|
| **Promotion (16w)** | ≥ 0.80 | **≥ 0.58** | Best model (fc3af3fc) expected ~0.61 under new formulas. 0.80 is unreachable. |
| **IS max_drawdown** | < 15% | **< 25%** | ALL GLD models IS DD 18-22% under equity-based metrics. 15% blocks everyone. |
| **OOS max_drawdown** | N/A | **< 20%** | OOS DD ~13-16% for GLD. 20% provides headroom. |
| **Demotion (16w)** | < 0.65 | **< 0.40** | Proportional reduction. |
| **Consecutive evals** | 5 | **5** | No change needed. |

---

## Ready for Promotion

| Rank | Model | Task | Score | Sharpe | MaxDD | Expectancy | Ops | cecpp | Backtest | Recommendation |
|------|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|------------|-----|-------|----------|----------------|
| *(none)* | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | **Pipeline RESET. No promotion until thresholds recalibrated + 5 new evals.** |

---

## Tier 1: Reference Models (Not Promotable — IS DD Blocked)

These models show the best absolute quality metrics. They serve as benchmarks but IS DD exceeds any reasonable threshold.

| Model | Task | 16w Sharpe | 16w DD | 16w cecpp | 16w Ops | 16w Net | 16w Excess | IS DD | Blocker |

| `[[model/4fc2c04e]]` 🏆 | `[[task/a72da2ed]]` EXP-11 | **1.95** | **7.97%** | **0.968** | 118 | $3,026 | **+3.77%** | **20.55%** | IS DD > 25% threshold unlikely but model sets the quality ceiling |
| `[[model/aee99e33]]` ⭐ | `[[task/880c9eb3]]` EXP-16 XLE | **2.09** | **5.42%** | **0.975** | 415 | $2,502 | **+0.16%** | TBD | **XLE BREAKTHROUGH** — best risk-adjusted metrics in platform. Brand new (Mar 14). |
| `[[model/48467932]]` | `[[task/880c9eb3]]` EXP-16 XLE | **1.84** | **5.66%** | **0.972** | 584 | $2,170 | -2.69% | TBD | XLE high-frequency variant. 584 ops (record). |

---

## Tier 2: GLD Pipeline Candidates (Awaiting New Evals)

All GLD models show IS DD 18-22% and 16w DD 13-16% under new equity-based metrics. These are the strongest actively-trading GLD models.

| Rank | Model | Task | 16w Sharpe | 16w DD | 16w cecpp | 16w Ops | 16w Exp | 16w Net | 16w Excess | IS DD | IS cecpp |
|------|-------|------|-----------|--------|-----------|---------|---------|---------|------------|-------|----------|
| 1 | `[[model/fc3af3fc]]` 🏆 | `[[task/8b877f86]]` EXP-21 | 1.14 | 16.08% | 0.896 | 92 | $32.83 | $2,298 | -1.73% | **21.80%** | 0.911 |
| 2 | `[[model/374cdefc]]` | `[[task/03255fc1]]` EXP-23 | 1.11 | 16.22% | 0.897 | 93 | $34.63 | $2,355 | -1.72% | **22.00%** | 0.915 |
| 3 | `[[model/949a3128]]` 🆕⭐ | `[[task/f29a02cc]]` EXP-30 | 1.13 | **13.90%** | 0.897 | 81 | $29.52 | $1,919 | -6.13% | TBD | TBD |
| 4 | `[[model/5ebc573b]]` 🆕 | `[[task/32062f72]]` EXP-15 | 1.11 | 15.17% | 0.895 | 84 | $31.29 | $2,221 | -3.77% | TBD | TBD |
| 5 | `[[model/d763df9d]]` 🆕 | `[[task/eb1b1e97]]` EXP-20 | 1.10 | 16.39% | 0.892 | **108** | $27.26 | $2,290 | -2.28% | TBD | TBD |

**Key findings:**
- **`[[model/949a3128]]`** (EXP-30, DD-weighted + pop=300) has the **lowest 16w DD of any actively-trading GLD model** (13.90%). 2.2pp below fc3af3fc. Watch closely.
- **`[[model/d763df9d]]`** has the **highest ops count among GLD models** (108). More trades = better statistical grounding.
- `[[model/fc3af3fc]]` and `[[model/374cdefc]]` are **virtually tied** on all metrics. Both excellent quality. Differentiation will emerge from new-formula evals.
- **ALL GLD models have negative excess_return_pct** under equity-based metrics — they underperform buy & hold (23.2%) by 1.7-6.1pp. Only 4fc2c04e and aee99e33 beat B&H.

---

---

## Degrading (Action Needed)

| `[[model/54b33aea]]` 💀 | `[[task/1d615d47]]` EXP-14 | 0.775 (stale) | ↓↓ all horizons | Declining | Worsening | No | **TERMINAL.** Independent of metric change. Task disabled. |

---

## New Models Since Last Cycle (Mar 15)

|-------|------|----------------|----------------|-------|
| `[[model/949a3128]]` ⭐ | `[[task/f29a02cc]]` EXP-30 | 0.655 | **cecpp 0.897, DD 13.9%** | Lowest GLD DD. Pipeline candidate. |

---

## XLE Instrument Breakout 🆕

**XLE models show dramatically better risk-adjusted metrics than GLD under equity-based accounting:**

| Metric | GLD Best (fc3af3fc) | XLE Best (aee99e33) | Delta |
|--------|--------------------|--------------------|-------|
| 16w Sharpe | 1.14 | **2.09** | +83% |
| 16w Max DD | 16.08% | **5.42%** | -66% |

| 16w Ops | 92 | **415** | +351% |

**Assessment:** XLE models are brand new (Mar 14) and need more evaluation history. But the quality gap is striking. If IS DD is reasonable, XLE models could leapfrog GLD for promotion consideration. Recommend Strategist explore more XLE experiments.

---

## IS DD Summary (New Equity-Based Metrics)

ALL GLD models showed identical pattern this eval cycle: **8w declined, 4w spiked**. By next week, the bad data should age out of the 8w window too.
